_note: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE for the admin harness (spec item 30) - added 2026-10-17 by the standing QA/robustness review after finding a real bug (QA-Edge-Case-Findings.md) in engine/fill_docx_forms.py: the C.1.2.3 Contract Data form's 'Project Leader' and 'Design Specialist' key-person rows were always filled with the company's SIGNATORY (key_people[0]) regardless of who is actually confirmed for those positions. That bug was invisible on all 3 existing fixtures because each of them has exactly one key person who is simultaneously the signatory, the PL and the DS1 - a shape that happens to match Klipcorp's own real data, but not a company of any real size. This fixture is deliberately a DIFFERENT shape on two axes Sarel asked this review to cover: (1) three distinct key people, with the signatory being neither the PL nor the DS1 - the normal shape once a company has more than one qualified person; (2) a Design Specialist whose discipline is Structures, not Klipcorp's Pavement and Materials - the other 7 of 8 Book 1 DS specialisms (app/lib/sanralMatrices.ts) had no test-company coverage at all before this. Unlike the other 3 fixtures, this one also carries 'role_people' directly (normally synthesized at runtime by engine/pack/process_pack_jobs.py's gather() from tender_pack_assignments, never stored in a real company's own profile) so the admin harness's existing fill_docx_forms.py/fill_a_forms.py direct-call path - the one check that actually catches this bug class - exercises it on every run, not just the full web-to-Supabase pipeline (which cannot run in this environment - Gap #9).
